original_test_intent: Verify Advanced-RAS ADDDC bank-level sparing without plus1 on the approved x4 DIMM population, with a passing harasser, correct bank/slot attribution, indicators off and maintained system health.
original_method: An operator installs the specified DIMMs and an FAE provides Advanced-RAS bank/no-plus1 settings plus a resolved target recipe. A single bounded harasser run is executed and correlated against bank topology, Cscript, platform events, indicators and health before restoration.
manual_activity: A qualified operator performs x4-DIMM service, selects the documented bank-mode/no-plus1 configuration, runs the harasser and checks LEDs; the agent can verify the bank map and analyze collected evidence.
required_inputs: ITP/CScripts build/hash and Advanced-RAS bank contract
Resolved harasser parameters, plus1-disabled value and socket/mc/ch/bank coverage
PASSED, bank/slot correctable, indicators-off and health oracle
ESD, abort, recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: ESD-safe powered-down DIMM service and independent console
Prove bank organization and trained topology before ADDDC
One approved bank/no-plus1 run with self-check enabled
Stop on wrong bank, UCE, failed PASSED, light assertion or instability
No automatic retry; restore and verify memory health
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied bank map/parameters and collect read-only Cscript, Windows, BMC, UEFI and health evidence
Do not install DIMMs, change RAS settings, infer bank/parameters, inject/retry or set verdict
engineer_actions: Define bank-to-slot, indicator and health acceptance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH grep cannot distinguish bank from rank sparing, establish no-plus1 or prove the harasser and system-health criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve every DeviceSparingHarasser variable using the bank/no-plus1 package contract; do not reuse rank or plus1 inputs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Advanced RAS Bank without plus1, x4 64 GB DIMMs, adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False and 30/30 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture DIMM bank organization and trained topology, run one resolved bank-targeted no-plus1 harasser, correlate PASSED and correctable slot events with health and off indicators, then restore/diff state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit bank identity and auditable health acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic corrected logs cannot identify a bank-level sparing transition or exclude the rank/plus1 paths.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect bank map can exercise the wrong fault domain and cause an unexpected UCE or crash.

expected_evidence: DIMM PN/slot/bank map and trained topology
Package hash and exact bank/no-plus1 parameters
BIOS/ADDDC state and full PASSED transcript
Windows/BMC/UEFI bank/slot correctable evidence and indicators off
Health metrics, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names bank mode, but Procedure has no bank selector/map and leaves every harasser argument unresolved. DIMM bank population, target coverage, Windows evidence and measurable normal-operation/UEFI applicability are absent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The bank/no-plus1 ADDDC purpose is clear and can be executed once an FAE supplies the recipe, map and recovery controls.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 25 Wistron-System RAS-00745-V003: approve 64 GB x4 DIMM slot/bank organization and Advanced-RAS bank-mode BIOS settings; ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact DeviceSparingHarasser runTime/adddc/adddcType/plus1-disabled/socket/mc/ch/bank coverage; define PASSED, bank/slot correctable events, indicators-off, Windows health, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Preserves bank-level ADDDC as its own coverage unit and prevents rank/no-plus1 or bank/plus1 evidence from satisfying it.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bank-level sparing must demonstrate that the package selected the intended bank fault domain and mapped it to the expected DIMM slot. The common source call contains no visible bank selector and no concrete values, so only the FAE contract can explain how adddcType and topology establish this variant. Physical work remains manual, but map checking and multi-plane evidence are automatable; this supports a gated hybrid classification and records the missing bank recipe as a source conflict.
